paper_title: Particle Physics Implications of a Recent Test of the Gravitational Inverse Square Law
coupling_convention: (g_P^n)^2/(4*pi*hbar*c), dimensionless squared coupling as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper constrains multiple exotic forces from gravitational ISL test: scalar/vector Yukawa (ScalarNucleon/VectorBL), chameleon, dilaton/radion, PVLAS scalar phi-gamma-gamma (g_phigammagamma < 1.6e-17 GeV^-1 for m<20meV), and gamma5 pseudoscalar couplings to neutrons (Fig 5). Fig 5 shows (g_n^P)^2/(4pi) vs pseudoscalar mass but no numerical values are given in text/tables. SN1987a comparison: 8e-14 < (g_n^P)^2/(4pi hbar c) < 8e-8. Related benchmark Gamma=2.56e-10*beta3 with |beta3|<1.3e-4. No extractable numerical (mass,coupling) pairs from the plot.
